links.outcome: Evidence-unsupported answers in causal QA with conservative causal demotion versus lift-only retrieval
links.effect: Conservative causal demotion reduced evidence-unsupported answers from 17.3% to 6.1% at fixed retrieval recall; accuracy 37.2% vs 35.7% for lift-only.
links.quote: In a leakage-controlled causal QA benchmark, lift-only retrieval achieves 35.7% accuracy; conservative causal demotion achieves 37.2% while reducing evidence-unsupported answers from 17.3% to 6.1% at fixed retrieval recall.
